    Point–brick data without sincerity #

    PointBrick' is PointBrick without the condition that V is nonzero at every vertex other than x. It still gives a Kronecker pair whose extensions respect the cover (pair_of_pointBrick'), hence the support-free critical node (criticalNode'_of_point'). Two independent cocycles give PointBrick' (pointBrick'_of_cocycles).
